labels: The lace-bearing quarters of an Oxford shoe meet in a narrow closed V and are stitched beneath the vamp at the base of the lacing.; 옥스퍼드 구두의 끈 구멍이 난 양 날개가 좁고 닫힌 V자로 만나며 끈 아래쪽에서 뱀프 밑에 봉제되어 있다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: The lace-bearing quarters of an Oxford shoe meet in a narrow closed V and are stitched beneath the vamp at the base of the lacing.
aliases: 옥스퍼드 구두의 닫힌 레이싱
